description: Catalog reads and outcome reports: quotes, compare, audit, freshness. Use for those and to report an outcome. Not for a first pick (decide), a live API error (rescue), or stack changes since your last cursor (session_brief). Only report_outcome writes state; every other op is a read. Ops: prices: quote estimate compare free. Audit: check audit_repo freshness changes stack_delta coverage failures. Map: stack bundle search kit answer. Write: report_outcome. op=help lists args.
